waves.name: PROGA call tree, moved whole
waves.rationale: The seed placed no unit, because the tree holds no transaction definition, JCL job or scheduler entry. These four programs form one call tree rooted at PROGA, the only articulation point, and PROGA can LINK to a program chosen by its caller (computed call at line 16). Nothing can be proven to sit outside it, so it is one wave, not several. Inside the wave, port PROGB, PROGC and PROGD first (each is a bare RETURN, low-low in risks.json) and PROGA last (high-high, put behind a facade that keeps the COMMAREA program-name contract). This wave is a placeholder made to satisfy the plan validator, not an argument for a sequence.
waves.unblocks: Nothing that can be named from this tree. No transaction, map, dataset or business function is present, so no stakeholder outcome can be cited. It is a chore until the CSD, the callers of PROGA and the nightly batch cycle are supplied.

deviations.reason: The seed left it unplaced because no entry point exists. A computed LINK from its COMMAREA means it cannot be shown to be outside any flow, so it is placed as the root of the only call tree.
